DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車はどちらから見当たらなくなりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where did the bicycle go missing from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自宅の駐輪場所です。盗まれたのかと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅の自転車がなく盗難を心配していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bicycle parking at home. I came because I thought it might have been stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your bicycle is missing from home and you are worried about theft. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族などが使うことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do family members or anyone else use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 弟も使います。今日はまだ弟に聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 弟も利用し今日は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My younger brother does too. I have not asked him today yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your younger brother also uses it and has not been asked today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に自分で置いた時刻と場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us when and where you last parked it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨夜七時に自宅へ置きました。弟が借りた可能性もあるので、盗まれたと断定せず相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後の駐輪情報と貸出可能性を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: At home at seven last night. My brother may have borrowed it, so I want to ask without asserting it was stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate last-parking details from the possibility it was borrowed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 弟さんに連絡はできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今連絡しましたが返事がありません。借りたとも借りていないとも、まだ確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 弟に連絡したが利用の有無は未確認と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I just did, but there is no reply. I have not confirmed either that he borrowed it or that he did not.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you contacted your brother but his use remains unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態で伺います。自転車の特徴や登録の情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will hear it on that basis. Do you have the bicycle's features and registration information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真と登録の控えがあります。弟から返事があれば、その内容も改めてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特徴資料を示し返事があれば更新すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a photo and registration copy. If my brother replies, I will tell you that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show identifying documents and say you will update them when you receive a reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今確認できている情報を記録し、届け出の相談と家族への確認を分けて進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will record what is currently confirmed and proceed with the report inquiry separately from checking with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送の前に確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you want to check before shipping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この証明書は厳封とあります。名前を確かめるため開けましたが、のりで閉じ直せばそのまま送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 厳封書類を名前確認で開け貼り直して送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This certificate says it must remain officially sealed. I opened it to check the name. Can I send it as it is if I glue it shut again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you opened an officially sealed document to check the name and ask whether resealing permits sending it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 郵便の受付で、閉じ直した書類を未開封だったものとして認めることはできません。提出先の指定をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: At postal acceptance, we cannot recognize a resealed document as having been unopened. Please check the submission destination's requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開けた事実は変わらないのですね。封を戻して未開封と説明せず、提出先に開封したことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 貼り直しを未開封とせず提出先へ開封の事実を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So opening it remains a fact. I will not reseal it and describe it as unopened; I will tell the destination I opened it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not call a resealed document unopened; tell the destination the opening fact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行元にも、書類の扱いや再発行について相談できます。書類そのものを書き換えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also ask the issuer about handling or reissuing the document. Did you alter the document itself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ、中身は書き換えていません。封を開けた状態を残して、発行元に取り直しが必要か聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身未改変と開封状態を示し発行元へ再発行の要否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, I did not change the contents. I will preserve its opened condition and ask the issuer whether it needs to be issued again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that contents are unaltered and ask the issuer whether reissuance is needed, showing its opened state. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出期限も相談するときに伝えてください。発送方法を速くするだけでは、書類の条件は確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also give the submission deadline when asking. Choosing faster shipping alone does not confirm document acceptability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 期限は来週の月曜日です。速い便なら開封の問題も済むとは考えず、期限と書類の条件を先に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限を伝え速い便では書類条件の問題を解消しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The deadline is next Monday. I will not assume express delivery solves the opening issue; I will discuss the deadline and document conditions first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the deadline and explain that fast shipping does not resolve document conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談後に、発送する書類と指定の方法が決まれば、こちらで配送の受付条件をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After your inquiries, once the document to send and required method are decided, we can explain delivery acceptance conditions here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日はまだ差し出しません。提出先と発行元の返事を確認し、送る書類が整ってから発送方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発送を保留し提出先と発行元の返答後に配送を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not post it today. I will check replies from the destination and issuer and ask about shipping once the documents are ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold shipping and ask about delivery after replies from destination and issuer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日は発送せずお持ち帰りください。相談の際には、厳封指定と開封済みであることを分けずにお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please take it home without sending today. When asking, explain both the sealed-document requirement and that it has already been opened together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 現在のお仕事について伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask about your current work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週この会社で面接があるので、そこに勤務すると書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 面接予定の会社を勤務先欄に書くか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an interview at this company next week. May I write that I work there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to list a company where you have an interview as your workplace. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の状況と今後の予定を分けて確認しましょう。採用や開始日は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the current situation separately from future plans. Have hiring or a start date been decided?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。面接予定だけで採用されたとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 採用と開始日は未定だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. An interview alone does not mean I have been hired.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that hiring and the start date are undecided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在はお仕事をされていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今はしていません。現在は求職中で、来週面接予定と分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在求職中と今後の面接予定を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I will state separately that I am currently job-seeking and have an interview next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate current job seeking from a future interview. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その状況に応じて担当が確認します。口座を使う目的はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check according to that situation. What will you use the account for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 生活費の管理です。まだ決まっていない会社の給与口座としては説明しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 生活費管理が目的で未定の給与用途を確定として言わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Managing living expenses. I will not describe it as a salary account for a company that is not yet decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State living-expense management without presenting an unconfirmed salary purpose as certain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な資料と条件を確認します。予定が変わった場合の扱いも聞きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the necessary documents and conditions. Do you also want to ask what happens if your plans change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。採用が決まった場合に、勤務先の情報を改めて伝える必要があるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 採用後に情報更新が必要か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please tell me whether I need to report my workplace information again if I am hired.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask whether information needs updating after hiring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当から現在の申し込み条件と、状況が変わった場合の確認方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member will explain current application conditions and how to check if your situation changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札のどの部分が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the price tag concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きい数字では百八十円なのに、別の数字は二百十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの価格表示の違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The large number says one hundred eighty yen, but another number says two hundred ten yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about two different price displays. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの数字の近くに条件が書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are there conditions written near each number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 百八十円は会員価格です。小さい文字を見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 安い方が会員価格で条件を見落としたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One hundred eighty is the member price. I did not see the small print.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the lower price is for members and you overlooked the conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会員の条件を満たすか、確認して選びましょう。会員登録されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us choose after checking whether you meet membership conditions. Are you registered?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 登録していません。百八十円で買えると決めず、通常の支払額を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未登録なので通常支払額の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I will not assume I can buy for one hundred eighty; I want to check the normal payment amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are unregistered and ask to check the regular amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通常価格の表示はこちらです。会員登録もご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the regular price. We can also explain membership registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は登録するつもりはありません。登録費用や条件を読まず、安い数字だけで申し込みたくないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件を読まず即登録せず今日は通常購入すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not intend to register today. I do not want to apply based only on the lower number without reading registration costs and conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not register immediately without reading conditions; state ordinary purchase today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通常価格で比較できます。こちらの商品は登録なしで税込み百九十円です。この条件ならご予算に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can compare regular prices. This product is one hundred ninety yen including tax without registration. Does that fit your budget?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、二百円以内なので、登録せずに買えるこちらの百九十円の商品にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通常価格が税込百九十円の別商品を予算内として選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, it is within two hundred yen, so I will take this one-hundred-ninety-yen product available without registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose another product with a regular tax-inclusive price of one hundred ninety within budget. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。会員登録はせず、通常価格が税込み百九十円のこちらの商品として会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will not register you as a member; we will ring up this product at its regular price of one hundred ninety yen including tax.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩されるのはお一人ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今は一人ですが、このあと家族と犬を連れて戻る予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 後から家族と犬を連れて来る予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: For now, yes, but I plan to return later with my family and dog.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you plan to come later with family and a dog. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では犬連れで使える道や条件も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then let us also check paths and conditions for bringing a dog.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、今私が通れる道を、そのまま犬と歩ける道と思わずに確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人だけの通行と犬連れの条件を分けて聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I do not want to assume paths I can use now are also usable when walking with the dog.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask separately about passage alone and conditions with a dog. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 犬連れの案内を担当に確認します。休憩もされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the dog-related information with the staff member. Will you also rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族と交代で座れれば十分です。犬をベンチの上に乗せるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩の希望と犬をベンチに乗せない意思を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is enough if my family and I take turns sitting. I do not intend to put the dog on a bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your rest preference and intention not to put the dog on benches. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用範囲と過ごし方の案内をご確認ください。犬は現在どちらにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the permitted areas and guidance for spending time here. Where is the dog now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家で家族といます。入れない範囲があるなら、連れて来る前に家族へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来園前に利用範囲を家族へ知らせると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: At home with my family. If there are restricted areas, I will tell my family before bringing the dog.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your family the permitted areas before visiting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の案内をまとめてお伝えします。どの入口で合流されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will summarize the current guidance. Which entrance will you meet at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口はまだ決めていません。利用できる道を確認してから、家族と入口を合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認後に家族と合流入口を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We have not decided. I will check usable paths first and then agree on the entrance with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will choose the meeting entrance with family after checking conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。犬連れの条件と入口を確認してから、散歩の予定を立ててください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check dog conditions and the entrance before making your walking plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの乗り換えをご利用ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この案内です。五分とあるので、次の駅まで五分乗るのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 五分表示を次駅までの乗車時間と理解したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This one. It says five minutes, so that means five minutes on the train to the next station, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you interpreted the five-minute display as train travel to the next station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 五分の横には徒歩とあります。列車を降りて乗り場を移る時間の表示ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Beside five minutes it says on foot. It shows the time to walk between platforms after leaving the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本当ですね。同行者に五分で次の駅へ着くと伝えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 徒歩表示に気づき同行者への説明の誤りを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: You're right. I told my companion we would reach the next station in five minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice the walking label and explain the incorrect information given to your companion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次の列車の時刻も確認しましょう。同行者は同じ列車にいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the next train's time too. Is your companion on the same train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、隣にいます。まず説明を訂正して、一緒に歩く時間を確保します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者へ訂正して二人の移動時間を確保すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, next to me. I will correct my explanation first and allow time for us to walk together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the explanation to your companion and allow walking time for both. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗り換え通路を案内します。途中で買い物をされる予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will show you the transfer passage. Were you planning to shop on the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飲み物を買う予定でしたが、この五分に買い物の時間も含まれるとは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 買物時間は徒歩表示に含まれないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was going to buy a drink, but I will not think shopping time is also included in these five minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that shopping time is not included in the walking display. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の列車までの余裕を確認してから選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the time available before the next train and then choose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、余裕がなければ先に乗り場へ向かいます。どの案内を目印に歩くか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 余裕がなければ先に乗場へ向かう方針と目印を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. If there is no spare time, we will go to the platform first. Please tell me which signs to follow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will go to the platform first if time is short and ask about landmarks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 乗り換え先の表示をお示しします。徒歩時間、待ち時間、次の乗車時間を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will show the transfer destination signs. Let us check walking time, waiting time, and the next train's travel time separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 必要な証明書の案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought the instructions for the certificate you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。今年のものと聞いたので、今日発行されたものならよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 当日発行なら指定を満たすか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here. I was told this year's one, so is anything issued today acceptable?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether same-day issuance satisfies the specification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発行日と証明する年度は別です。案内の年度の欄を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The issue date and fiscal year certified are separate. Let us check the fiscal-year field in the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 令和七年度とあります。今日の日付だけ見ればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定年度と発行日を取り違えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says fiscal year Reiwa seven. I thought I only needed to look at today's date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused the specified fiscal year with the issue date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その年度のどの証明が必要か、担当が確認します。提出期限はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check which certificate for that fiscal year is needed. Is there a submission deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来週です。古い年度の指定だから期限切れとは考えず、指定通りの証明を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出期限を伝え指定年度の証明を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Next week. I will not treat a previous fiscal-year specification as expired; I want to ask for the certificate as specified.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the deadline and ask about the specified fiscal year's certificate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な記載項目も確認できます。案内に種類の名前はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can also check required fields. Do the instructions name the certificate type?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 課税証明とあります。似た名前の別の証明を、自分で代わりに選ばないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 課税証明指定を示し似た別証明で代用しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Taxation certificate. I will not choose a different similarly named certificate as a substitute myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the taxation-certificate specification and say you will not substitute a similar certificate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当窓口へご案内します。提出先に追加で聞きたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will show you to the responsible counter. Is there anything else you want to ask the destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発行後何日以内という条件があるか聞きたいです。年度とは別の条件として確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発行からの期間条件を年度と別に確認したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want to ask whether it must be issued within a certain number of days. I will check that as a separate condition from the fiscal year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to check the period since issuance separately from the fiscal year. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。種類、年度、発行日の条件を整理してから申請しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us organize the type, fiscal year, and issue-date conditions before applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 痛みのある側は、右でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: The painful side is the right, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、向かいの方から見て右だと思って書きました。私の左肩です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職員視点で右と書いたが本人の左肩だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, I wrote right from the viewpoint of the person opposite me. It is my left shoulder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct that you wrote right from the staff member's viewpoint but mean your left shoulder. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の左肩ですね。問診票の欄を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your own left shoulder, then. Let us check the questionnaire field together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。右に付けた丸を、そのまま残さず訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 誤った丸の訂正方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I would like to correct the circle I put on right rather than leave it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to correct the wrong circle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 訂正方法を受付で案内します。肩以外にも痛む場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Reception will explain how to correct it. Is there pain anywhere other than your shoulder?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左の首の付け根も痛みます。肩だけの話にせず、場所を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左首の付け根の痛みも別部位として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The left base of my neck also hurts. I will describe the locations separately rather than only mention the shoulder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report pain at the left base of the neck as a separate site. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 痛みが始まった時の様子は説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you describe what was happening when the pain started?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日、荷物を持ち上げたときです。原因は自分では決められませんが、その後に気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を持ち上げた後の発症経過を原因断定せず説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yesterday, when I lifted luggage. I cannot determine the cause myself, but I noticed it afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe onset after lifting luggage without asserting a cause. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経過を診療担当へ伝えます。動かすときと、じっとしているときでは違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the clinical staff that sequence. Does it differ when you move and when you stay still?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 上げると強く痛み、座っているときも少し痛みます。動かさないと全く痛くない、とは書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 動作時と安静時の痛みを分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: It hurts strongly when I raise it, and slightly even when sitting. I will not write that it is completely painless when I do not move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe movement pain separately from resting pain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本人から見た左右、部位、経過、動作による違いを記録して診療担当に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will record left and right from your perspective, the sites, sequence, and movement-related differences and tell the clinical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような連絡についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What message would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物を受け取って転送する仕事を頼まれましたが、届いた箱は知らない人の名前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転送の仕事で届いた荷物が他人名義だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was asked to do a job receiving and forwarding parcels, but the box that arrived is in an unknown person's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a parcel received for a forwarding job is in someone else's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 仕事の依頼元や、箱の宛名について説明を受けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Were you given an explanation of the job's requester or the box's addressee?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メッセージだけで引き受けました。会社の資料はなく、他人の名前についても説明はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メッセージだけの依頼で会社資料と名義説明がないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I accepted through messages alone. There are no company documents or explanation of the other name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the request was messages only with no company documents or explanation of the name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物はもう別の場所へ送っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you already sent the parcel elsewhere?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。今日になって転送先も変わり、すぐ送るよう言われたので相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未転送で転送先変更と急ぐ要求を受けたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. The forwarding destination changed today, and I was told to send it immediately, so I came for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain no forwarding yet, the changed destination, and urgent demand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は荷物をどのように保管していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: How are you storing the parcel now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自宅で未開封のままです。中身を調べるために開けず、指示通り送ることも止めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅未開封で開封も発送も止めていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: At home unopened. I have not opened it to investigate or sent it as instructed; I have stopped both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it remains unopened at home and both opening and shipping are on hold. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 依頼のメッセージと、送り状の情報は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you kept the request messages and shipping-label information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分で依頼者へ荷物を返す前に、保管と連絡についてどう対応するか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料を残し自己判断で返送せず保管と連絡を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Before returning it to the requester myself, I want to ask what to do about storage and contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the materials and ask about storage and contact without returning it on your own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容と経緯を伺います。依頼元、宛名、変更された転送先を分けて確認し、荷物の扱いも担当へ相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will hear the contents and circumstances. Let us check the requester, addressee, and changed forwarding destination separately and consult the staff member about the parcel too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱で発送されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you ship using this box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中の本を送りたいです。この箱は友達から借りたので、あとで返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本を送り箱は友達へ返す予定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to send the books inside. I borrowed this box from a friend, so I will return it later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to send books and return the borrowed box to your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この箱を梱包に使うと、箱も一緒に発送されます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you use this box for packing, the box will be shipped too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。受付で中身だけ移してくれると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中身だけ受付で移すと思った誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I thought the counter would transfer only the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your misunderstanding that the counter would move only the contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の梱包を用意する方法を確認できます。今の箱には友達の名前もありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can check ways to prepare different packaging. Your friend's name is on the current box too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、この箱では送りません。本を出して、自分で使ってよい箱を用意したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 借り箱を使わず別の梱包を用意したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I will not send it in this box. I want to take out the books and prepare a box I am allowed to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not use the borrowed box and want other packaging. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身の重さや大きさに合うものを選びましょう。ほかに入れる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us choose something fitting the contents' weight and size. Is there anything else to include?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本だけです。借りた箱の中にあった友達の紙は、本と分けて返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友達の紙を発送する本から分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only books. I will separate my friend's paper that was in the borrowed box from the books and return it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will separate your friend's paper from the books being sent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい箱を用意したら、送り先も改めて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you have a new box, please also confirm the destination again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。借りた箱の古い送り状を写さず、今回の相手の住所で新しく準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い送り状を使わず今回の住所で準備すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not copy the borrowed box's old shipping label; I will prepare a new one with this recipient's address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use the current recipient's address rather than an old label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。中身と借り物を分け、新しい梱包ができてから発送方法を相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Separate the contents from borrowed items and ask about shipping after the new packaging is ready.
